comments.snippet:
This report came from 1.84.0 (Release 3716), the stable release of 2026-09-25. It is the same crash as #209 and #220: `ComboBox.OnFontChanged` during a DPI change, with the Quick Connect box left without its window at 51 USER objects, so not a handle quota problem.

The repair from 745a32bc3 is not in 1.84.0. After a DPI change it gives the Quick Connect box its window back and adds the `Win32 error:` code to this report. This time we had three independent automated reviews re-check that repair ...
